query: What calibration schedule (burn-in lines, frequency of recalibration, threshold-triggered retraining) and measurable thresholds will maintain κ≥0.75 over the pilot and scale-up?

response.query: What calibration schedule (burn-in lines, frequency of recalibration, threshold-triggered retraining) and measurable thresholds will maintain κ≥0.75 over the pilot and scale-up?
response.answer: To maintain κ≥0.75, recalibrate annually, perform burn-in lines every 6 months, and retrain thresholds when accuracy drops below 0.70.

results.title: STATE OF THE ART: CCS TECHNOLOGIES 2025
results.content: • Oxy-combustion with heat recycling boosts performance and cycle efficiency • Pure CO 2, CDRs, and other valuable byproducts can reduce power costs far below traditional sources with PCCC • Overall plot size is smaller than that of a traditional power block + PCCC • In 2024, 8 Rivers entered into an MOU with PacifiCorp, parent of Rocky Mountain Power, to evaluate a potential carbon capture project at one of the utility’s existing power plant sites in Wyoming • The project will deploy 8 Rivers’ AFC technology and direct-fired supercritical CO 2 turbines being developed with Siemens Energy, who will provide continued support through the Pre-FEED and subsequent FEED • On March 12, 2025, 8 Rivers awarded Wood an agreement for the project’s preliminary front end engineering design (Pre-FEED).
